annotations.title: Add or remove an event's co-host or door staff (hosts)

description: Adds, changes or removes a Co-host or Door staff member on an event the signed-in person hosts, by their mobile number, as the organizer dashboard's Team panel does. `role` is cohost (every host power except money, deleting the event, removing the host and changing the team), door (scan, check in, walk-ins, open the door, counts; nothing else) or none to remove them. Nothing is sent to them: tell them yourself; they get the role the next time they sign in with that number. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with a `requestId` and changes nothing; read it out, and only when the host says yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `requestId`. Refusals (NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_HOST, NOT_ENABLED, BAD_PHONE, BAD_ROLE, NOT_SELF, NOT_THE_HOST, NOT_ON_TEAM, CONFIRM_INVALID) are read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which changes nothing; true with requestId saves.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the host says it.

phone.description: The person's mobile number, as the host says it.

requestId.description: The requestId the first call returned.

role.description: cohost, door, or none to remove them.
